subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
12. 
During discussions on the above matters, the branch manager suggested that the auditor 
should avoid reporting the irregularities so that the borrower’s banking relationship is not 
affected. 
 
Considering this situation described in the case, which of the following ethical principles 
should primarily guide the auditor’s response? 
(a)  
Integrity and Objectivity. 
(b)  
Confidentiality. 
(c)  
Professional Behaviour. 
(d)  
Professional Competence and Due Care.
